summary: Both occurrences are already in the entry and confirm its single Detransitive sense '(Detrans.) baumeln, pendeln'. Neither introduces a new sense, stem, box or idiom.
The Infectum at 45/23 describes ongoing dangling within a sequence, while Part. Pass. at 61/134 predicates a suspended state. No active transitive counterpart or external causer is expressed.
The snake's support is eba (b-, referring to the dagger). The bride's rope is reader-supplied preceding context, not an overt argument of the supplied verse.

Keep the inherited I label and base forms mdawdəl/midawdəl, and the Detransitive location of both boxes. Four radicals and intransitive motion meaning do not warrant relabeling the entry or moving its examples to active boxes.
